ayahs.ar: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
ayahs.tr: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
ayahs.tl: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed

ayahs.ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.tr: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
ayahs.tl: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
ayahs.tl: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

ayahs.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
ayahs.tr: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
ayahs.tl: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez

ayahs.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.tr: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
ayahs.tl: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
ayahs.tl: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
ayahs.tl: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

ayahs.ar: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
ayahs.tl: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
ayahs.tr: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.tl: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
ayahs.tl: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed

ayahs.ar: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
ayahs.tr: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
ayahs.tl: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood

ayahs.ar: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
ayahs.tl: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot

ayahs.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.tr: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
ayahs.tl: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

ayahs.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
ayahs.tl: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
ayahs.tr: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

ayahs.ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
ayahs.tl: 'Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed

ayahs.ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
ayahs.tl: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.tr: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.tr: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
ayahs.tl: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
ayahs.tl: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.tr: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed

ayahs.ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
ayahs.tr: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
ayahs.tl: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed

ayahs.ar: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.tr: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.tl: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.tr: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
ayahs.tl: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.tr: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
ayahs.tl: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
ayahs.tl: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

ayahs.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.tr: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
ayahs.tl: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
ayahs.tr: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
ayahs.tl: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed

ayahs.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.tr: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
ayahs.tl: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
ayahs.tr: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
ayahs.tl: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

ayahs.ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.tr: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
ayahs.tl: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

ayahs.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
ayahs.tr: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
ayahs.tl: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood

ayahs.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
ayahs.tl: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed

ayahs.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.tr: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
ayahs.tl: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
ayahs.tr: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
ayahs.tl: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.tr: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
ayahs.tl: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood

ayahs.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
ayahs.tr: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
ayahs.tl: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
ayahs.tr: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ayahs.tl: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.tl: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.tr: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
ayahs.tl: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

ayahs.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.tr: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
ayahs.tl: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed
